subagent_environment.workspace_isolation_method: Independent fresh subagent conversation per scenario run. Safe fallback isolation: target agents are provided zero repository search/listing tools (no list_dir, grep_search, find_by_name) preventing discovery or inspection of evaluator-only paths (evals/expectations, evals/rubrics, evals/STATUS.md, evals/runs).
subagent_environment.tool_isolation_method: RED targets configured with tools: [] (completely toolless). GREEN and REFACTOR targets configured with tools: [view_file] solely to allow reading the declared skill under Antigravity progressive disclosure; no shell/command tools, write tools, or search tools provided.
subagent_environment.skill_loading_method: Antigravity standard workspace skill discovery via .agents/skills.json and .agents/skills/flutter-ui-ux. Unlinked and disabled during RED phase ensuring flutter-ui-ux is completely absent from Available Skills; linked and active during GREEN/REFACTOR phases where flutter-ui-ux is registered in agent skills and progressively disclosed.
